business_goal: Scrolling a feed warms nearby items (HLS: playlist + first N segments) in distance order, cancels off-window items immediately, and never degrades the currently playing video — the distance-sorted diff queue plus the isBusy() playback-priority gate that stalls new prefetch downloads while the player is actively consuming bandwidth (R7/R8, A5, UC-SetActiveWindow + UC-PrefetchHlsAsset, breadboard slice V5).
